option_relations.rationale: Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) is a syndrome that can be associated with various underlying conditions, including lymphomas, but it is not a T-cell lymphoma itself. Therefore, it is unrelated to the leaf 'T-cell lymphoma'.
Infectious Mononucleosis (EBV-associated HLH) describes a cause of HLH, but it is an infectious disease, not a T-cell lymphoma. Therefore, it is unrelated to the leaf 'T-cell lymphoma'.
Subcutaneous panniculitis-like T-cell lymphoma (SPTCL) is a recognized subtype of T-cell lymphoma, making it a subtype of the provided leaf 'T-cell lymphoma'.
Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified, is a diagnostic category within T-cell lymphomas, thus representing a subtype of the provided leaf 'T-cell lymphoma'.
